# 2005 Elections

There were 4 elections held in Jersey in 2005.

- **[Trinity Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2005#e33)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[Senators General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2005#e6)**

  6 seats · 15 candidates · 42.6% turnout
- **[St Brelade Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2005#e26)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · Turnout unknown
- **[Deputies General Election](https://flow.je/elections/2005#e7)**

  29 seats (6 uncontested) · 56 candidates · 33.4% average turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2005 Trinity Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [Trinity](https://flow.je/elections/trinity) (1 seat), 4th October 2005.

**[John Gallichan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-gallichan) was elected as Connétable of Trinity in 2005 unopposed**.
